summary: Positions 0-149: Haiku kept 67 as photo; 45 fine as they are (keep_ok, includes 8 of the main_photo_wrong ids whose building is right but photo is not), 8 need a field fix (11 fixes over 8 buildings), 14 wrong (mostly towers and one doubtful architect credit), 9 with a weak main photo. Rescued 10 from skip/unsure. Skips left alone: duplicates 6, 22, 35, 57, 108, 120, 127, 141; empty leads; demolished; no photos; interior-only photos. Notes: no dup_flag field exists in prep.json, so I checked all kept and rescued entries against site/data/buildings.js by qid, id and 250 m distance; nothing new on the wall. Unverifiable offline: Shizuoka (SANAA credit), Centre Ceramique year 1995. Haiku's 'Selene (building)' id is kept as given.
